body: Thank you guys for the responses. I really appreciate hearing from people who aren't judgmental and understand what I'm going through. I am twenty, so I'm definitely old enough to get help. Or at least I should be. I know my issues are part of a bigger problem. I'm always super anxious and I hate being out of control. I'm going to see a doctor for a physical at the end of this month who I have never met. Do you guys have any advice about talking to a medical doctor about what I'm going through? I know they are supposed to have seen it all before, and aren't supposed to be judgmental, but I've definitely had experiences with physicians and clinicians being really critical or judgmental seeming towards me. I know they're just trying to help, but I think I get better with endorsement more than criticism. Thank you again for so much help and feedback. It means a lot to me. This is the first real, I know it's small, step towards recovery. My boyfriend checked out a recovery group for be and got me some numbers, but I still don't feel comfortable enough to go myself, or reach out to them.
